pages.text: Akaishi Fire Necklace (necklace slot, 1M buffer): consumes 20 energy/tick to maintain Fire Resistance I.
Akaishi Blast Charm (body slot, 1M buffer): cancels explosion damage at a rate of 1 damage point per 100 energy.$(br2)Explosion immunity lasts until the buffer is depleted.
Shared mechanics and the slot map are in the $(l:akaishi:curios)Akaishi Trinkets$(/l) overview; carry spare $(l:akaishi:portable_cell)Portable Cells$(/l) for extended use.
